description: Defines an enumeration LogType representing various log types related to connection logs, including their categories and utility methods.

classes.name: LogType
classes.description: Enumeration of different log types with associated categories and utility methods.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string label used in JSON representation for the log type.

methods.name: forType
methods.description: Static method to find a LogType matching a given string type.

methods.name: supportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if the log type supports a given log category.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the log type.
